name: amazon_browse_node
description: Amazon browse-node (category) tree, one row per (marketplace_code, id), carrying the node's name, parent, materialized ancestor path and whether it has children.

name: amazon_browse_node_attribute
description: Attributes of an Amazon browse node: one row per (marketplace_code, node_id, name) holding that attribute's value.

name: amazon_browse_node_query
description: Amazon's browse tree guide query for a browse node, one row per (marketplace_code, node_id): the query string as published, the same query parsed into a map of field name to values, and the item-type keywords hoisted out of it — which are the input to the product-type lookup in amazon_product_type_keyword.

name: amazon_country
description: Reference table of the countries Amazon operates in: one row per ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, with its display name, region and time zone.

name: amazon_fulfillment_center
description: Core fulfillment-center reference: one canonical country and established physical/forwarding address arrays per fulfillment-center code.

name: amazon_marketplace
description: Reference table of Amazon marketplaces: one row per marketplace id, with its short code, display name, country, default currency and language, storefront domain and time zone.

name: amazon_merchant
description: One row per Amazon seller account (merchant) known to this workspace, with its display name and whether it is currently active.

name: amazon_product_type_keyword
description: Amazon's mapping from an item-type keyword to the product types it belongs to, one row per (marketplace_code, item_type_keyword, product_type).

name: amazon_store
description: One row per (merchant, marketplace) storefront the seller sells on, with its marketplace code, country and display name.

name: amazon_vendor_adapi_profile
description: One row per Amazon Vendor store and marketplace, holding the Advertising API profile a person assigned to it by hand.

name: amzadapi_billing_v3__invoice
description: One Amazon Advertising invoice of one ads profile, fetched in full, per (merchant, profile, invoice).

name: amzadapi_eligibility_v1__program
description: Amazon Ads program eligibility per (merchant, marketplace, program), with the eligibility flag and any reasons Amazon gave for ineligibility.

name: amzadapi_exports_v1__ad
description: One advertising ad per (merchant, marketplace, ad id) from the Amazon Ads API exports endpoint, with its ad group, campaign, ad product, state, delivery status and creative.

name: amzadapi_exports_v1__adgroup
description: One advertising ad group per (merchant, marketplace, ad group id) from the Amazon Ads API exports endpoint, with its campaign, ad product, state, delivery status, bid and optimization settings.

name: amzadapi_exports_v1__campaign
description: One advertising campaign per (merchant, marketplace, campaign id) from the Amazon Ads API exports endpoint, with its ad product, state, flight dates, budget caps, targeting settings and delivery status.

name: amzadapi_exports_v1__target
description: One advertising target per (merchant, marketplace, target id) from the Amazon Ads API exports endpoint, with its campaign and ad group, target type and expression, bid, negative flag and delivery status.

name: amzadapi_reports_v1__product01__byDay
description: Daily Amazon Ads product-attribution report: one row per day, ad entity and converted-product dimension, showing which advertised products led to purchases of which converted products.

name: amzadapi_reports_v1__search_asin_placement__byDay
description: Daily Amazon Ads search-term and placement report: one row per day, ad entity, target, search term and placement, with impressions, clicks, cost, purchases, units sold and sales.

name: amzspapi_catalog_items_v20220401__catalogitem
description: Core SP-API Catalog Items 2022-04-01 record per (marketplace_code, asin): dimensions, identifiers, thumbnail, product type, parent ASIN, variation theme and summaries.

name: amzspapi_catalog_items_v20220401__itemattributes
description: The full SP-API Catalog Items 2022-04-01 attribute document per (marketplace_code, asin), stored verbatim in data.

name: amzspapi_catalog_items_v20220401__itemattributes_lang
description: The language-specific SP-API Catalog Items 2022-04-01 attribute document per (marketplace_code, lang, asin), stored verbatim in data.

name: amzspapi_catalog_items_v20220401__itemimages
description: The SP-API Catalog Items 2022-04-01 image set per (marketplace_code, asin), stored verbatim in images.

name: amzspapi_searchCatalogItems_v2020__asin
description: Per-ASIN metadata dimension for search-catalog scrapes, keyed (marketplaceId, asin): item name, brand, image, parent ASIN and summaries.

name: amzspapi_searchCatalogItems_v2020__rank
description: One ranked ASIN per SP-API searchCatalogItems scrape, keyed (targetId, scrapeTime, rank).

name: amzspapi_searchCatalogItems_v2020__scrape
description: One completed SP-API searchCatalogItems scrape per (targetId, scrapeTime), recording the depth, page and item counts and the run's status.

name: amzspapi_searchCatalogItems_v2020__target
description: Registry of SP-API searchCatalogItems scrape units: one row per (merchant, marketplace, keyword, locale), addressed by the deterministic targetId that keys its scrapes and ranks.

name: amzagg_profit__adSkuDay
description: Per-SKU daily advertising cost and attributed sales: the Sponsored Ads search-term and placement report summed per merchant, marketplace, day, budget currency, advertised SKU and advertised ASIN, over its rows with an advertised SKU.

name: amzagg_profit__ledgerDay
description: Per-store and per-day dashboard summary of the accrual ledger and the open order lines: the amount, units and contributing rows of each dashboard line, by the day the dashboard shows them (the order date for a sale, its cost of goods and an open order line, the booked day otherwise).

name: amzagg_profit__ledgerProductDay
description: Per-product and per-day dashboard summary of the accrual ledger and the open order lines, the product grain of amzagg_profit__ledgerDay.

name: amzagg_profit__openOrderLine
description: Dashboard-only open order lines: each Amazon storefront ALL_ORDERS line not cancelled whose units the accrual ledger has not booked yet, with ordered, booked and open units and the open units' prorated money and fee estimate.

name: amzagg_profit__orderItemContextSku
description: Per-SKU fee-preview fields the open order lines' fee estimate applies, written by the accrual ledger's rebuild for the SKUs of the open order lines it computes, only the rows that changed.

name: amzagg_profit__orderItemSurchargeDay
description: Fee-surcharge rate per marketplace and order day, measured from the merchant's settled orders of the 90 days ending on that day; written by the accrual ledger's whole-merchant walk and read by the open order lines' fee estimate.

name: amzfact_ledger_diagnostic
description: What the accrual ledger noticed about one of its transactions: an unmapped breakdown path, an unknown transaction type, a priced sale release record with no deferred record, money left without a SKU because its order has several SKUs or its sources name different ones, a release whose amounts changed, a sale line without an order date, a title transfer without units, a product item with no SKU whose description is a known code for a charge, more units booked for an order line than it ordered, units no configured cost covers, a restock that found no costed unit of its order to take back, a tax posting without a taxable base, tax paid by a configured tax entity whose jurisdiction could not be derived, or a reverse charge in a country the entity recovers no tax in.

name: amzfact_ledger_merchant
description: Per merchant, the state of its accrual ledger: the ledger version and status of the last build, the first day of the books, the merchant's region, and the build's times and counts.

name: amzfact_ledger_posting
description: One posting of a ledger transaction: a signed amount against an account.

name: amzfact_ledger_saleLine
description: One SKU of one booked sale (a deferred shipment record or a title transfer): its units, its dates and its settlement link.

name: amzfact_ledger_transaction
description: One balanced transaction of a merchant's accrual ledger: a sale, a release, a refund, a fee, a payout, a day's advertising, an advertising invoice's true-up, payment or reverse charge, the COGS of a shipped sale or title transfer, the cost of a replacement, a unit put back in stock, a return loss for a refunded unit that does not come back to sellable stock, a warehouse loss Amazon paid for, or another booked event, with its marketplace day and, where the source has one, its instant.

name: amzspapi_finances_v20240619__Transaction
description: One SP-API Finances 2024-06-19 transaction event per (merchantId, transactionKey), with the full event in doc.

name: amzfact_fnsku_fbaInventory_history
description: Per-day FBA inventory history at the physical grain: one row per (merchant, marketplace, FNSKU) and marketplace-local calendar date, with the lowest, highest, first and last fulfillable and buyable future-supply quantities among the changes recorded that day.

name: amzfact_fnsku_fbaInventory_latest
description: Current FBA inventory at the physical grain: one row per (merchant, marketplace, FNSKU), with the whole quantity tree flattened.

name: amzfact_fnsku_ledger_estimate
description: FBA inventory ledger estimated from amzreport_LEDGER_DETAIL for the days after the merchant's newest amzfact_fnsku_ledger_history day: one row per (merchant, fulfillment center, FNSKU, disposition) and day with a detail event, cumulative from the key's newest summary row.

name: amzfact_fnsku_ledger_history
description: FBA inventory ledger facts at the physical grain: one row per (merchant, fulfillment center, FNSKU, disposition) and DAILY/FC summary day, restated from amzreport_LEDGER_SUMMARY.

name: amzfact_fnsku_ledger_latest
description: Current position per FBA ledger key (merchant, fulfillment center, FNSKU, disposition): the key's newest amzfact_fnsku_ledger_history row extended by the detail events after the merchant's newest summary day, collapsed to one row.

name: amzfact_sku_identity
description: What a seller SKU points at: one row per (merchant, seller SKU) carrying FNSKU, ASIN and condition.

name: amzop_latest__byStoreAsin
description: Latest observation time per (type, merchant, marketplace, ASIN) across the listing and orders report sources.

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__InboundOrder
description: An AWD inbound order — the supplier-to-AWD leg — one row per (merchantId, orderId).

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__InboundShipment
description: An AWD inbound shipment on the supplier-to-AWD leg, one row per (merchantId, shipmentId).

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__InboundShipmentSkuQuantity
description: One SKU line on an AWD inbound shipment, one row per (merchantId, shipmentId, sku).

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__Inventory
description: Amazon Warehousing and Distribution (AWD) on-hand inventory, one row per (merchantId, sku).

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__ReplenishmentOrder
description: An AWD replenishment order — the AWD-to-FBA leg — one row per (merchantId, orderId).

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__ReplenishmentOrderProduct
description: One requested product line on an AWD replenishment order, one row per (merchantId, orderId, sku), so replenishment demand is joinable by SKU.

name: amzspapi_awd_v2024__ReplenishmentOutboundShipment
description: An outbound shipment summary on an AWD replenishment order, one row per (merchantId, shipmentId) — the only record of the AWD-to-FBA shipping leg, which is why it is a table rather than JSON on the order.

name: amzspapi_fbaInbound_v0__ShipmentItem
description: One item line on an FBA inbound shipment as reported by the older FBA Inbound API, one row per (merchantId, shipmentId, msku).

name: amzspapi_fbaInbound_v2024__InboundPlan
description: An FBA inbound plan, one row per (merchantId, inboundPlanId).

name: amzspapi_fbaInbound_v2024__Shipment
description: An FBA inbound shipment, one row per (merchantId, shipmentId).

name: amzspapi_fbaInbound_v2024__ShipmentItem
description: One line item on an FBA inbound shipment, one row per (merchantId, shipmentId, index), where index is the position of the line within one full walk of that shipment's items.

name: amzspapi_fbaInventory_v1__InventorySummary
description: Latest FBA inventory summary per (merchant, marketplace, seller SKU) from SP-API FBA Inventory v1, with the full summary — fulfillable, inbound, reserved, researching and unfulfillable quantities — in doc.

name: amzms_v1__adgroups
description: Latest Amazon Marketing Stream state of one ad group, per (advertiser, marketplace, ad group).

name: amzms_v1__ads
description: Latest Amazon Marketing Stream state of one ad, per (advertiser, marketplace, ad).

name: amzms_v1__budget_usage
description: Amazon Marketing Stream budget-usage events, one row per (advertiser, marketplace, update time, budget scope, scope type, ad product), with the full event in doc.

name: amzms_v1__campaigns
description: Latest Amazon Marketing Stream state of one advertising campaign, per (advertiser, marketplace, campaign).

name: amzms_v1__sb_clickstream
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Brands clickstream events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sb_conversion
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Brands conversion events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sb_rich_media
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Brands video and rich-media metrics, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sb_traffic
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Brands traffic events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sd_conversion
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Display conversion events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sd_traffic
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Display traffic events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sp_conversion
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Products conversion events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__sp_traffic
description: Amazon Marketing Stream Sponsored Products traffic events, append-only: one immutable row per event, keyed by idempotency id within the (advertiser, marketplace, time window) stream.

name: amzms_v1__targets
description: Latest Amazon Marketing Stream state of one advertising target, per (advertiser, marketplace, target).

name: amzspstream_ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED notifications, one row per message, carrying the previous and current account status and the full notification in payload.

name: amzspstream_ANY_OFFER_CHANGED
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon ANY_OFFER_CHANGED notifications, one row per message, carrying the affected ASIN and the full notification in payload.

name: amzspstream_B2B_ANY_OFFER_CHANGED
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon B2B_ANY_OFFER_CHANGED notifications, one row per message, carrying the affected ASIN and the full notification in payload.

name: amzspstream_DETAIL_PAGE_TRAFFIC_EVENT
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon DETAIL_PAGE_TRAFFIC_EVENT notifications.

name: amzspstream_FBA_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY_CHANGES
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon FBA_INVENTORY_AVAILABILITY_CHANGES notifications.

name: amzspstream_FEE_PROMOTION
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon FEE_PROMOTION notifications, one row per message, carrying the fee promotion type.

name: amzspstream_FEED_PROCESSING_FINISHED
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon FEED_PROCESSING_FINISHED notifications, one row per message, carrying the feed id, feed type and processing status.

name: amzspstream_FULFILLMENT_ORDER_STATUS
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon FULFILLMENT_ORDER_STATUS notifications, one row per message, carrying the seller fulfillment order id, event type and fulfillment order status.

name: amzspstream_ORDER_CHANGE
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon ORDER_CHANGE notifications, one row per message, with the full notification in payload.

name: amzspstream_PRICING_HEALTH
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon PRICING_HEALTH notifications, one row per message, carrying the issue type and affected ASIN.

name: amzspstream_REPORT_PROCESSING_FINISHED
description: Append-only landing table for Amazon REPORT_PROCESSING_FINISHED notifications, one row per message, carrying the report id, report type and processing status.

name: amzspapi_orders_v0__Order
description: One SP-API Orders v0 order per (merchantId, marketplaceId, orderKey), with the full order document in doc.

name: amzspapi_orders_v0__OrderItem
description: One SP-API Orders v0 order line per (merchantId, marketplaceId, orderItemKey), with the full item document in doc.

name: amzreport_ALL_ORDERS
description: Order line items from the Amazon all-orders report (GET_FLAT_FILE_ALL_ORDERS_DATA_BY_LAST_UPDATE_GENERAL), one row per (merchant, marketplace, Amazon order id, SKU).

name: amzreport_COUPON_PERFORMANCE
description: Coupon performance from GET_COUPON_PERFORMANCE_REPORT, one row per (merchant, marketplace, coupon).

name: amzreport_FBA_CUSTOMER_RETURNS
description: Customer returns received at Amazon fulfillment centres, from GET_FBA_FULFILLMENT_CUSTOMER_RETURNS_DATA, one row per returned unit group keyed (merchant, return date, order, FNSKU, index), with the disposition, reason and status of the return.

name: amzreport_FBA_FEE_PREVIEW
description: Estimated Amazon selling and fulfilment fees per (merchant, marketplace, SKU), from GET_FBA_ESTIMATED_FBA_FEES_TXT_DATA, with the item's dimensions and weight.

name: amzreport_FBA_INBOUND_NONCOMPLIANCE
description: Inbound shipment noncompliance events Amazon reports against a shipment: delivery delays, labelling issues, carton quantity mismatches and tracking problems.

name: amzreport_FBA_INVENTORY_PLANNING
description: FBA inventory-health metrics per (merchant, marketplace, SKU) from GET_FBA_INVENTORY_PLANNING_DATA.

name: amzreport_FBA_REIMBURSEMENTS
description: Itemized FBA inventory reimbursements from GET_FBA_REIMBURSEMENTS_DATA, one row per (merchant, reimbursement, index), with the reason, amount and the quantities reimbursed in cash and in inventory.

name: amzreport_FBA_REMOVAL_ORDER_DETAIL
description: Removal-order lines from GET_FBA_FULFILLMENT_REMOVAL_ORDER_DETAIL_DATA, one row per (merchant, request time, order, SKU, index), with the requested, cancelled, disposed, shipped and in-process quantities and the removal fee.

name: amzreport_FBA_REMOVAL_SHIPMENT_DETAIL
description: Removal-shipment tracking from GET_FBA_FULFILLMENT_REMOVAL_SHIPMENT_DETAIL_DATA, one row per (merchant, request time, order, SKU, index), with the carrier, tracking number, disposition and shipped quantity.

name: amzreport_FBA_STORAGE_FEE
description: Estimated monthly FBA storage fees from GET_FBA_STORAGE_FEE_CHARGES_DATA, one row per (merchant, country, month of charge, FNSKU, fulfilment centre, index), with the item's measured volume and average quantity on hand.

name: amzreport_LEDGER_DETAIL
description: FBA inventory movements from the Inventory Ledger detailed view (GET_LEDGER_DETAIL_VIEW_DATA), one row per event keyed (merchant, date, FNSKU, event type, index), with the quantity moved, the fulfilment centre, disposition and reason.

name: amzreport_LEDGER_SUMMARY
description: FBA inventory movement summaries from the Inventory Ledger summary view (GET_LEDGER_SUMMARY_VIEW_DATA), one row per (merchant, time unit, period start, location level, location, FNSKU, disposition).

name: amzreport_MERCHANT_LISTINGS_ALL
description: Every listing in the seller's catalogue, from GET_MERCHANT_LISTINGS_ALL_DATA, one row per (merchant, marketplace, seller SKU) with the report row in doc.

name: amzreport_OPEN_LISTINGS
description: Listings currently available for sale, from GET_FLAT_FILE_OPEN_LISTINGS_DATA, one row per (merchant, marketplace, seller SKU) with the report row in doc.

name: amzreport_PROMOTION_PERFORMANCE
description: Promotion performance from GET_PROMOTION_PERFORMANCE_REPORT, one row per (merchant, marketplace, promotion): glance views, units sold and revenue, per-product metrics in includedProducts, and a derived asins lookup array.

name: amzreport_SALES_AND_TRAFFIC__skuByDay
description: Daily sales and traffic per (merchant, marketplace, date, SKU) from GET_SALES_AND_TRAFFIC_REPORT, with the report's salesByAsin and trafficByAsin blocks in sales and traffic.

name: amzreport_SALES_AND_TRAFFIC__store
description: Storefront-wide sales and traffic per (merchant, marketplace, granularity, date) from GET_SALES_AND_TRAFFIC_REPORT — not broken down by SKU — with the report's salesByDate and trafficByDate blocks in sales and traffic.

name: amzreport_SEARCH_CATALOG_PERFORMANCE
description: Brand Analytics search catalogue performance per ASIN and reporting period, from GET_BRAND_ANALYTICS_SEARCH_CATALOG_PERFORMANCE_REPORT.

name: amzreport_SEARCH_QUERY_PERFORMANCE
description: Brand Analytics search query performance per (ASIN, search query, reporting period), from GET_BRAND_ANALYTICS_SEARCH_QUERY_PERFORMANCE_REPORT, with the query's score and volume and the impression, click, cart-add and purchase blocks.

name: amzreport_SETTLEMENT_V2
description: Transaction rows of a V2 settlement report (GET_V2_SETTLEMENT_REPORT_DATA_FLAT_FILE_V2), one row per (merchant, settlement, index), where index is the 1-based position in the report excluding its summary row.

name: amzreport_SETTLEMENT_V2__summary
description: One row per V2 settlement (GET_V2_SETTLEMENT_REPORT_DATA_FLAT_FILE_V2): the settlement period, deposit date and total amount, taken from the report's summary row.

name: amzreport_VENDOR_SALES
description: Amazon Vendor Retail Analytics sales per merchant, marketplace, distributor view, selling program, report period, period start and ASIN, from GET_VENDOR_SALES_REPORT.

name: amzreport_VENDOR_TRAFFIC
description: Amazon Vendor Retail Analytics glance views per merchant, marketplace, report period, period start and ASIN, from GET_VENDOR_TRAFFIC_REPORT.

name: amazon_ads_ad
description: Merged live view of Amazon advertising ads: the periodic Export table (amzadapi_exports_v1__ad) reconciled with the near-realtime Amazon Marketing Stream snapshot (amzms_v1__ads), on the same merge semantics as amazon_ads_campaign.

name: amazon_ads_adgroup
description: Merged live view of Amazon advertising ad groups: the periodic Export table (amzadapi_exports_v1__adgroup) reconciled with the near-realtime Amazon Marketing Stream snapshot (amzms_v1__adgroups), on the same merge semantics as amazon_ads_campaign.

name: amazon_ads_campaign
description: Merged live view of Amazon advertising campaigns: the periodic Export table (amzadapi_exports_v1__campaign) reconciled with the near-realtime Amazon Marketing Stream snapshot (amzms_v1__campaigns).

name: amazon_ads_target
description: Merged live view of Amazon advertising targets: the periodic Export table (amzadapi_exports_v1__target) reconciled with the near-realtime Amazon Marketing Stream snapshot (amzms_v1__targets), on the same merge semantics as amazon_ads_campaign.

name: amazon_fba_inventory_summary
description: DEPRECATED — do not build on this view.

name: amazon_listing_all
description: Flattened view of all merchant listings — active, inactive and incomplete — with full product metadata, from the GET_MERCHANT_LISTINGS_ALL_DATA report (amzreport_MERCHANT_LISTINGS_ALL).

name: amazon_listing_open
description: Flattened view of currently open listings with consumer and B2B pricing, from the GET_FLAT_FILE_OPEN_LISTINGS_DATA report (amzreport_OPEN_LISTINGS).

name: amazon_orders_by_day_and_sku
description: Daily order-item totals per SKU from amzspapi_orders_v0__OrderItem: one row per (local date, merchant_id, marketplace_id, sku, asin, currency), with the order count, quantities ordered and shipped, and price, tax and promotion totals both including and excluding tax.

name: amazon_sales_and_traffic
description: Flattened view of sales and traffic by SKU and date: the amzreport_SALES_AND_TRAFFIC__skuByDay report with every sales and traffic metric extracted into its own column rather than left nested.
